description: This file defines the EmployeeDirectoryAPI class, which is a REST API endpoint for managing and retrieving employee directory information within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes methods for fetching individual employee details, listing employees with filters, and associated validation rules. It also includes metadata via OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPI
classes.description: REST API endpoint class for managing employee directory information, supporting retrieval of employee details and listing with filters, including validation and OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific employee identified by empNumber, returning either a default or detailed model based on request parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employees based on optional filters and pagination, returning a collection result.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring empNumber exists.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method, validating query parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeDirectoryService
methods.description: Returns an instance of EmployeeDirectoryService used for data operations.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Determines the model class (default or detailed) based on query parameters.
